game_concept: A action defense set in Frost Peaks – Rockfall Chute, a rockfall chute: the rescue climber must handle snow leopards while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Vowel Counter: Count vowels in words by looping over characters.
theme: Frost Peaks – Rockfall Chute: a rockfall chute
core_gameplay_loop: In Rockfall Chute, repeat each round: Count vowels in words by looping over characters. Each round, snow leopards strike the cliff anchor, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the vowels value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the cliff anchor from snow leopards in Rockfall Chute: keep the vowels meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 42-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: vowels drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 42-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 1 (intro tier): Vowel Counter
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Vowel Counter' (Week 8 slot 6), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Rockfall Chute'. code_snippet:
for ch in word:
    if ch in 'aeiou':
tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how vowels changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against snow leopards in Rockfall Chute.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 42 seconds while vowels > 0.
